Livestock Weighted Average Report for 10/2/2026 - Final

AUCTION
                                                          This Week                  Last Reported                       Last Year
                                                                                       9/4/2026
Total Receipts:                                          1,014                          559                             1,142
Feeder Cattle:                                           1,014(100.0%)                 559(100.0%)                      1,142(100.0%)

This month's special feeder calf sale featured black and black and white face steer and heifer feeder calves. Compared to the previous sale on
9/4/26, feeder steers were 52.00 higher and feeder heifers were 26.00 higher. Receipts were higher compared to the previous sale and good
demand was noted with active trade both in person and online. The next feeder auction is scheduled for November 6, 2026. Supply included:
100% Feeder Cattle (61% Steers, 39% Heifers). Feeder cattle supply over 600 lbs was 24%.
